Oval.style_goal: Maintain natural balance without disrupting facial symmetry.
frames_to_avoid: Oversized frames that cover too much of the face
Oval.pro_tip: Choose frames that are as wide as (or slightly wider than) the broadest part of the face.

Round.style_goal: Add definition and structure to create the illusion of a longer, thinner face.
Round.pro_tip: Bold, angular lines help break up the face's roundness and add much-needed contrast.

Square.style_goal: Soften the strong angles of the jaw and forehead to create a more balanced look.
Square.pro_tip: Choose frames that sit high on the bridge of the nose to elongate the appearance of the face.

Oblong.style_goal: Add width and break up the vertical length of the face.
Oblong.pro_tip: Look for frames with 'tall' lenses and a low bridge to create a horizontal emphasis.

Heart.style_goal: Minimize the width of the forehead and balance the narrow chin.
frames_to_avoid: Oversized styles that draw attention upward
Heart.pro_tip: Frames that are wider at the bottom help add visual 'weight' to the lower half of the face.

Diamond.style_goal: Soften the cheekbones and add width to the narrow forehead and jawline.
Diamond.pro_tip: Focus on styles that highlight the eyes and browline to balance out prominent cheekbones.
